topic: Updating frame data and azimuth requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating attributes for a large number of frames (62) provided by JCD and CC. Initially, there was confusion regarding which fields needed updating; it was clarified that all existing columns—including coordinates and type—must be updated, not just the newly marked yellow fields.

A major technical hurdle is determining the 'Angle to North' or azimuth for these new frames. While one participant suggested checking old files, another noted that since the frames are brand new installations, this approach might fail. It was determined that if historical data cannot provide the angle, manual input per frame may be necessary.

Separately, a decision was made regarding the readiness of the Gabon project, which needs to be moved to production.
decisions: All existing columns (coordinates, type, etc.) must be updated for the frames from JCD and CC, not just new fields.
The Gabon project deployment date needs to be rescheduled to today's production slot.
action_items: Check old files for azimuth data, but prepare for manual input if necessary.
Someone (Andrey Fishman) will review and set the angle/azimuth for the 62 frames after they are uploaded.
